  <section v="7">

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the garments of thought, speech, and action have a higher root than the soul itself, and therefore performing mitzvos elevates the soul while worldly actions lower it.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that this matter
(that thought, speech, and action are garments)
is also one of the reasons why the matter of thought, speech, and action is more impactful than the emotions.
That is,
that the main thing demanded from each person is the service in thought, speech, and action,
is
(not only because they are in his domain as mentioned above,
but also)
because this is more impactful.
And this will be understood by prefacing what is explained in many places
regarding the garments,
that the root of the garments is above the root of the person who is clothed in them.
And this superiority that stems from their root
is discernible in them even after they have been drawn downward.
For this is why the garments encompass the person,
and add to him beauty and glory,
"Rabbi Yochanan called his garments 'my honorers,'"
because in their root they are above the person.
And similarly, it is also with the garments of the soul—thought, speech, and action—
that the root of the garments is above the soul.
Therefore,
through thought, speech, and action of the 613 mitzvos,
which are the garments of the Nefesh HaElokis,
an elevation occurs in the soul,
higher than it is in its own essence
[This is also why the mitzvos are garments for the soul, through which specifically it can enjoy the radiance of the Shechinah,
as explained at length in many places
and also in Likkutei Torah, the discourse beginning "Zeh,"
And through thought, speech, and action in worldly matters not for the sake of Heaven,
the garments of the Nefesh HaBahamis,
a descent occurs in the Nefesh HaBahamis, lower than it is in its own essence.
And since the Nefesh HaElokis is clothed in the Nefesh HaBahamis,
through the descent in the Nefesh HaBahamis,
a descent also occurs in the Nefesh HaElokis,
for the Nefesh HaBahamis brings down even the Nefesh HaElokis
(which is clothed within it)
downward, very low.
And this is why the main service of man is to turn from evil and do good in actual deed, in thought, speech, and action,
for the purpose of the soul's descent below is that through its service below it may ascend higher than it is in its own essence
(as it was before its descent),
and this ascent is specifically achieved through service in the garments of thought, speech, and action,
analogous to physical garments, through which specifically beauty and glory are added to the person who wears them, etc.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that conquering Jericho, the lock of Eretz Yisrael, through the service of turning from evil and doing good in thought, speech, and action, leads to the refinement of the emotions and the ultimate expansion of borders in the Messianic era.

translations.translation: And this is also why Jericho is the lock of Eretz Yisrael,
that through the service of turning from evil and doing good in thought, speech, and action
[and all the more so when there is also the service of sending the spies to Jericho,
to scout and examine the thought, speech, and action so that they are all for G-d],
through this one reaches
the refinement and transformation of the emotions—the conquest of the land of the seven nations,
and even to "when the L-rd your G-d will expand your border,"
the conquest of the land of the Kenite, Kenizite, and Kadmonite as well
—the three intellects,
with the coming of Mashiach Tzidkeinu,
very soon.
